1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400);
8:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // Ship definition (drawn as triangle)
11:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: width / 2, y: height - 30, speed: 6, color: '#0af' };
12:   // Sound assets (place audio files in same directory or adjust paths)
13:   const sounds = {
14:     thrust: new Audio('thrust.wav'),
15:     explode: new Audio('explosion.wav'),
16:     bgm: new Audio('bgm.mp3'),
17:   };
18:   // Configure sounds
19:   sounds.thrust.volume = 0.2;
20:   sounds.explode.volume = 0.5;
21:   sounds.bgm.volume = 0.3;
22:   sounds.bgm.loop = true;
23:   // Start background music (may be blocked until user interaction in some browsers)
24:   sounds.bgm.play().catch(() => {});
25:   let explosionPlayed = false;
26:   const keys = { left: false, right: false };
27: 
28:   // Asteroids (with rotation)
29:   const asteroids = []; // each: {x,y,r,s,angle,rotSpeed}
30:   // Stars for background
31:   const stars = [];
32:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
33:   const STAR_SPEED = 0.3;
34:   function initStars() {
35:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
36:       stars.push({
37:         x: Math.random() * width,
38:         y: Math.random() * height,
39:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
40:       });
41:     }
42:   }
43:   initStars();
44:   let lastSpawn = 0;
45:   let spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
46:   let speedInc = 0.02; // increase per second
47:   let score = 0;
48:   let gameOver = false;
49: 
50:   // Input handling
51:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
52:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
53:       keys.left = true;
54:       sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
55:       sounds.thrust.play().catch(() => {});
56:     }
57:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
58:       keys.right = true;
59:       sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
60:       sounds.thrust.play().catch(() => {});
61:     }
62:   });
63:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
64:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
65:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
66:   });
67: 
68:   function spawnAsteroid() {
69:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
70:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
71:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2 + (score / 1000);
72:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
73:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04; // radians per frame
74:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, s: speed, angle, rotSpeed });
75:   }
76: 
77:   function update(dt) {
78:     // Move stars background
79:     for (let s of stars) {
80:       s.y += STAR_SPEED;
81:       if (s.y > height) {
82:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
83:         s.y = 0;
84:       }
85:     }
86:     // ship movement
87:     if (keys.left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
88:     if (keys.right) ship.x += ship.speed;
89:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.w / 2, Math.min(width - ship.w / 2, ship.x));
90: 
91:     // spawn asteroids
92:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
93:       spawnAsteroid();
94:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
95:       // gradually increase difficulty
96:       spawnInterval = Math.max(200, spawnInterval - 10);
97:     }
98: 
99:     // update asteroids
100:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
101:       const a = asteroids[i];
102:       a.y += a.s;
103:       a.angle += a.rotSpeed;
104:       // collision detection (simple rectangle-circle)
105:       const dx = Math.abs(a.x - ship.x);
106:       const dy = Math.abs(a.y - ship.y);
107:         if (dx < ship.w / 2 + a.r && dy < ship.h / 2 + a.r) {
108:           gameOver = true;
109:           if (!explosionPlayed) {
110:             sounds.explode.play().catch(() => {});
111:             explosionPlayed = true;
112:           }
113:         }
114:       // remove off‑screen
115:       if (a.y - a.r > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
116:     }
117:     score += dt;
118:   }
119: 
120:   function draw() {
121:     // Background gradient
122:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
123:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
124:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
125:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
126:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
127: 
128:     // Stars
129:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
130:     stars.forEach(s => {
131:       ctx.beginPath();
132:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
133:       ctx.fill();
134:     });
135: 
136:     // Ship (drawn as triangle)
137:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
138:     ctx.beginPath();
139:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.h / 2);
140:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
141:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
142:     ctx.closePath();
143:     ctx.fill();
144: 
145:     // Asteroids with radial shading and rotation
146:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
147:       ctx.save();
148:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
149:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
150:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.r * 0.2, 0, 0, a.r);
151:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f88');
152:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
153:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
154:       ctx.beginPath();
155:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:       ctx.fill();
157:       ctx.restore();
158:     });
159: 
160:     // Score
161:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
162:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
163:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 1000), 10, 20);
164: 
165:     // Game over overlay
166:     if (gameOver) {
167:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
168:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
169:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
170:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
171:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
172:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
173:     }
174:   }
175: 
176:   let lastTime = performance.now();
177:   function loop(now) {
178:     const dt = now - lastTime;
179:     lastTime = now;
180:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
181:     draw();
182:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
183:   }
184:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185: })();

(End of file - total 185 lines)
